phase3_findings.description: workpad.py carries a pinned COUPLED copy of pr-note-block.py's strip/add transform bodies, but the coupling test pins only the four marker literals byte-identical; the transform bodies are pinned only by each side's independent behavioral test, so a divergent edit to one transform could pass both.
resolve-issue-pr.py / workpad.py _resolve_open_pr_for_issue sort by createdAt then take last; an exact createdAt tie is broken arbitrarily (no secondary tiebreak on number). Practically inert.

gh api --jq '.body' on a PR whose body is JSON null emits the literal string 'null', which passes the non-empty guards and would be treated as body text. Latent edge, not reachable in this flow (mirror only fires for flow-created PRs with real bodies); mirrors pre-existing refresh-pr-run-link pattern.
No comment rot or docstring/code mismatch found; the retired link-rewrite is consistently re-described as a note-strip across all sites.

No negative assertion that branch-setup no longer rewrites the [View run] link; a reintroduced refresh-pr-run-link.py call alongside the strip would not turn the suite RED. Retirement asserted only positively.

The selector->executor wiring inside _cmd_update_inner (workpad.py:~3979) is untested end-to-end; _stopped_note_text_for_mirror and _mirror_stopped_note_to_pr are tested in isolation but no test drives a real --status Failed/--reflection-kind blocked update through _cmd_update_inner to confirm the mirror fires after the PATCH (AC6 ordering).
_mirror_stopped_note_to_pr's empty-body early-return branch (workpad.py:~3707) is not exercised (the gate helper's equivalent path is).
APPROVE; all 9 ACs verified satisfied; no findings at or above Suggestion.

report: Blinded shadow review (iteration 4) of PR 2063 @ f313b37, issue #2060 scope only (git diff --merge-base origin/main). Full roster of 5 dispatched from fresh contexts (type-design-analyzer correctly gated out: no new types; pr-test-analyzer included: diff adds tests). All 5 returned real assessments -> coverage full. No Critical or Important findings from any reviewer. Six Suggestion-level notes total, all advisory coverage-gap or latent-edge observations where the shipped code is correct today. ACs 1-9 all verified satisfied against the shipped tree at HEAD by the final-pass reviewer and corroborated by code-reviewer/pr-test-analyzer. The change mirrors a stopped-run note block into an open PR body (Blocked/Failed/Cancelled terminals only; Complete writes none), moves the [View run] refresh to the gate job as its single owner, retires the branch-setup link rewrite in favor of a note strip, and strips the block at completion-time regeneration. Fail-closed empty-body guards, -->-sanitization marker-injection defense, best-effort AFTER-PATCH mirror absorber (AC6), and REST {owner}/{repo} gh api usage all verified. Verdict: APPROVE.
